## How the commands are produced

The pipeline is the same as in #45111, with these changes:

- **Agg/disagg siblings.** A key whose dashboard changelog names only its agg/disagg sibling is now pinned to that date only if the date has rows for its own lane. Before, GLM-5.2 B200 disagg would have dropped off the page after [InferenceX #4286](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4286) re-swept only the aggregated lane.
- **Generated config files.** srt-slurm writes the Dynamo frontend's `--router-policy-config` file from the recipe's `worker_selection`. The renderer now captures it, and the page shows it as `router_policy_config.yaml`, like `nginx.conf`.
- **Rules.**
  - Kept as submitted: worker flag `--gc-threshold`; Dynamo frontend flags `--router-session-affinity-mode`, `--router-decode-active-request-weight` and `--router-policy-config` (file shown inline); env `SGLANG_GDN_CHUNK_H_BV`, `SGLANG_GDN_CHUNK_H_NUM_STAGES`, `SGLANG_EAGER_INPUT_NO_COPY` and `FLASHINFER_ROUTING_FORCE_BLOCK_PER_TOKEN`.
  - Removed: `--gc-warning-threshold-secs` (only logs a warning) and `HF_HUB_OFFLINE` (SA pre-stages the checkpoints; readers download them).

Each lane is still rendered at the exact commit of the run that produced its data, or at the PR head while in progress.
- **Removed (SA-only settings):** the benchmark harness, cluster paths and caches, telemetry, and InferenceX's synthetic speculative acceptance (disclosed per deployment).
- **Replaced with placeholders:** IPs, ports and NICs.
- **Derived variants:** router and KV-offload variants that were not run are derived and labeled "Derived — not run".

The data files are generated, so there is no hand-written code to review here.

  - `mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects` passes.

- **Browser click-through.** A headless browser clicked through every combination of hardware, checkpoint, deployment, concurrency, KV tier and router on all six pages under `mint dev`, opening every tab.
  - That is 2,602 command sets: GLM-5.2 340, DeepSeek-V4 358, DeepSeek-V4.1 396, Qwen3.5 1,096, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 94 and Muse Spark Open 318.
  - The rendered commands match the expected text exactly, with no browser errors.
  - The "Copy link" URL of every deployment was reopened in a fresh tab and restored the same selection and tab (141 links).
  - The Deployment-panel footer link and section placement checks pass, and two pages that did not opt in show no link.
  - The copy buttons work on a plain-HTTP preview.
- **Decoder and KV flags.** The component's own decoder, run through Node, reproduces the Python-generated commands for all 2,602 combinations, including every point's measured tier. Every KV-cache flag in a shown command exists in the SGLang commit of its deployment's image.
- **Round trip and leak scan.** Every flag and variable of every submitted launch is kept, rewritten or removed by a rule, and no SemiAnalysis cluster artifact appears in the shown commands.
- **Diff against `main`.**

  | Page | Command sets |
  |---|---|
  | GLM-5.2 | 340 identical; 42 removed ([InferenceX #3933](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3933) not overlaid) |
  | DeepSeek-V4 | 358 identical |
  | DeepSeek-V4.1 | 312 identical; 60 changed and 36 removed ([InferenceX #4327](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4327)); 24 derived-HiCache rows of GB300 changed (new donor) |
  | Qwen3.5 | 962 identical; 12 changed, 24 removed and 90 added ([InferenceX #4333](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4333)); 32 changed (FP8 H200 `-mtp`, measured run) |
  | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | 76 identical; 16 changed, 50 removed and 2 added (B200/B300 back to their measured runs) |
  | Muse Spark Open | 266 identical; 28 removed and 52 added ([InferenceX #4317](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4317)); 24 removed (H100) |

- **Cluster environment.** The table matches the worker fingerprints of measured runs on every cluster with srt-slurm lanes.
- **Argument parsing.** 200 distinct `sglang.launch_server`, `dynamo.sglang`, `sglang_router.launch_router` and `dynamo.frontend` command lines are new since #45111. All parse in their own submission images (amd64 builds of the pinned digests; each image's amd64 and arm64 builds come from the same SGLang commit):
  - `dev-qwen35-agentx-gb300-42ad537de600@sha256:9b167808…` 82/82. The Dynamo commands were checked against Dynamo `b208989f`, which the launch builds from source;
  - `nightly-dev-cu13-20261013-7224fce1` 55/55;

  - `nightly-dev-cu13-20261014-684fea8a@sha256:ddae0e39…` 16/16;
  - `nightly-dev-20261019-3c560089` 15/15;
  - `nightly-dev-cu13-20261015-a6a8c560@sha256:0a1ba33a…` 8/8.
